importSection.title: Import budget and APU from Excel
importSection.help: Upload an Excel with the unit price list: "Items de Presupuesto" sheet (item, description, unit, quantity, and its unit price analysis code) and "Unitarios" sheet (the materials, labor and equipment detail of each item). The system automatically creates the budget items with their APU, and adds any missing supplies to the Price Book.
importSection.note: APU are imported as pure direct cost (without AIU); if your file indicates an AIU, enter it here so the budget totals match the original file. This creates a new budget version.

priceBook.importHelp: The file must have columns Tipo (material, mano_obra or equipo), Nombre, Unidad and Valor, and optionally Codigo. If an item already exists (same code, or same type and name if there's no code), its value is updated instead of duplicating it.

importSection.title: Import / update APU catalog from Excel
importSection.help: Upload the official unit price list Excel ("Items de Presupuesto" + "Unitarios" sheets). An APU with a new code is created; if the code already exists and its direct cost changed, it's updated — without touching budget items already added in existing projects (their value stays fixed, as always).
